title: PEG-Tab: Sampling-Time Record Repair and Release Control for Tabular Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.39630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained tabular generators can reproduce training records even when aggregate utility remains high. When retraining is unavailable or too costly, sampling and release are the remaining intervention points. We present PEG-Tab (Post-Training Energy Guidance for Tabular Synthesis), a post-training repair and release-control framework for frozen tabular generators. For each generated row, a generator-native operator creates two alternatives. A shared calibrated score compares the three candidates, favours lower-risk records, and applies a final release check. We instantiate this interface for GReaT, CTGAN, TVAE, and TabDDPM without updating their parameters. Across five datasets and four generator families, PEG-Tab reduces mean Near Copy from $0.078$ to $0.027$ and lowers aggregate Exact Copy to zero. Relative to a $3\times$ post hoc filter, it retains higher utility in 12 of 16 transfer settings and Pareto-dominates the filter in eight.

translated_title: PEG-Tab：面向表格数据合成的采样时记录修复与发布控制
translated_abstract: 预训练的表格数据生成器即使在整体效用仍然较高的情况下，也可能复现训练记录。当重新训练不可用或代价过高时，采样与发布就成为仅存的干预点。我们提出了PEG-Tab（面向表格合成的训练后能量引导），这是一个针对冻结表格生成器的训练后修复与发布控制框架。对于每一条生成的行记录，一个生成器原生的算子会创建两个替代方案。一个共享的校准分数对三个候选进行比较，偏好风险较低的记录，并执行最终的发布检查。我们在GReaT、CTGAN、TVAE和TabDDPM上实例化了该接口，而无需更新它们的参数。在五个数据集和四个生成器家族上，PEG-Tab将平均近复制率从0.078降低到0.027，并将总体精确复制率降为零。相对于3倍事后过滤器，它在16个迁移设置中的12个中保持了更高的效用，并在其中8个设置中实现帕累托占优。
tldr: PEG-Tab提出了一个无需更新参数的训练后修复与发布控制框架，通过为每条生成记录创建替代候选并使用共享校准分数择优发布，在冻结的表格生成器上将平均近复制率从0.078降至0.027、精确复制率降为零，同时在多数迁移设置中比3倍事后过滤器保持更高效用。
en_tdlr: PEG-Tab introduces a parameter-freezing post-training repair and release-control framework that generates two alternative candidates per sampled row and uses a shared calibrated score to favor lower-risk records, reducing mean Near Copy from 0.078 to 0.027 and Exact Copy to zero across four tabular generator families while retaining higher utility than a 3× post hoc filter in most transfer settings.
